item.text:
Three modules directly use `config.Settings`:

- The package CLI calls `Settings.from_env()` on startup outside the `bench` subcommand. It uses `log_level` to configure logging and `env` in the startup message. [`src/nvidia_ai/__main__.py`](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/__main__.py:19)
- The benchmark CLI uses the configured base URLs to build NVIDIA and Ollama endpoints. It requires the API key when NVIDIA is selected and uses the Ollama URL to fetch version and model digest metadata. [`src/nvidia_ai/bench.py`](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:379)
- The smoke test clears `APP_ENV`, `LOG_LEVEL`, and `DATA_DIR` and disables `.env` loading to verify the defaults `dev`, `INFO`, and `Path("data")`. [`tests/test_smoke.py`](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/tests/test_smoke.py:12)
